title: The Schizoid and the Oracle

sourceEvidence.excerpt: philosophical and anthropological investigation into a problem of cultural design. It does not offer a final political doctrine or claim that an ideology can become immune to corruption. It formulates a more modest and at the same time more difficult hypothesis: a culture can try to reduce its vulnerability to capture if it treats the limits of its own representations, the costs of formation, and the strategies of adversarial actors as constitutive parts of ideology, not as observations added af

hook: An answer can sound complete before we have learned how to question it.
readerPromise: The book asks whether a culture can build resistance to capture into its own beliefs. What would an ideology look like if its followers could still challenge its creators?
